derivation: feminine of the ordinal of G4004 (πεντήκοντα);
def: fiftieth (G2250 (ἡμέρα) being implied) from Passover, i.e. the festival of "Pentecost"

occurrences.text: And when the day of Pentecost was fully come, they were all with one accord in one place.
But I will tarry at Ephesus until Pentecost.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
